_doc: The Free Market's four scroll NPCs (spec #33, #111). npcs: the v83 NPC id (Npc.wz, String.wz/Npc.img), which rates it sells (scrolls.json rate keys: '100', '60', '10', 'dark70', 'dark30') and the x it stands at on the Free Market floor (910000000); the y is the floor foothold below x. The NPCs are v83's own scroll sellers: El Moth 1032103 (Ellinia), Barun 2022002 (Orbis), Tulcus 1052104 (Kerning City), Vega 2041016 (Ludibrium); each has art in v83 Npc.wz. Which NPC sells which rate is the owner's rule (#33 triage, tier C). prices: mesos per scroll by item slot, the same at every rate. tier B for the 100% scrolls (v83's NPC prices: 35,000 for armour scrolls, 70,000 for wand and staff scrolls), applied to the 60%, 10% and dark rates as our own rule (tier C). weapon_slots: the scrolls.json slots priced as weapons. Stock is fixed, unlimited and the same for every tier (tier C; Shop.stock): each rate of every scroll family whose equipment can drop for the character's job. Selling is not data: every shop buys equipment and scrolls at their WZ info/price (tier B). talk_range: how near the character stands to an NPC to talk to it with the NPC Chat key, px horizontally and vertically (tier C: ours).
